Params: {3: 'A bone-deep coldness bites at your skin the moment you step into the Mist. There is zero visibility just three feet beyond you.'}
{3: 'A faint scraping sound grazes past your ear, and a dark shadow closes in from behind—'}
{3: "A ripple stirs through the Mist. Nirvatia's arm hooks around your waist, pulling you back."}
{3: 'Claws rake past your nose, shredding a strand of Mist.'}
{3: 'Nirvatia presses her palm against the glass of the soul lantern.'}
{3: 'A warm golden light expands, and the thick Mist is driven back to its edges. A handful of gray shadows recoil as if scorched, vanishing back into the dark.'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "Don't step outside the lantern's area. I can't help you if you do.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Guided by the lantern's glow, you two press deeper into the forbidden grounds."}
{3: 'The Mist retreats at the edge of the light, then closes in silently behind you.'}
{3: "You walk on, your eyes tracing the churning Mist beyond the light's edge, and your brow creases deeper with every step."}
{2: 'This is the same Mist that causes the mist infection in the city.', 3: '70'}
{2: "What's in the city is just a diluted version of this...", 3: '71', 4: 'If this place is the source...', 5: '71'}
{2: "Your family's secrets and the illness gripping the city are connected.", 3: '72'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'But until the succession is complete, I know as little as you do.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "What the rite is, what the Mist is... We won't have any answer until we reach the very end.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'And once this is all over... maybe we can keep looking out for each other.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "I don't easily admire people, 【kuroname】, but you're one of them.", 4: '1'}
{2: "Does that mean you'd let me go if it came to it?", 3: '83'}

{3: "Neither of you says another word. You continue deeper in, and the Mist thickens, pressing the lantern's glow until it barely reaches the ground beneath your feet. You two instinctively draw closer to each other."}
{3: 'Then, you hear a small sound from beside you. Nirvatia, her eyes unfocused, stares into the depths of the Mist and murmurs to herself—'}
{3: 'You can feel Nirvatia trembling, and she cannot stop.'}
{2: 'Are you okay?', 3: '102', 4: "Something's been off about you since back there.", 5: '102'}
{3: 'Nirvatia freezes right as she says that. She snaps her head back, suddenly aware of what she just said.'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "Sorry, I... I wasn't talking to you.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Not me?', 3: '110', 4: 'Who else is in this godforsaken place?', 5: '110'}
{3: 'Nirvatia does not answer. A fine sweat beads at her temple, and her crystal-red eyes are glassy and unfocused, fixed on some empty point deep within the Mist.'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "【kuroname】, what's ahead is dangerous. Far more dangerous than you think.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "If you want to turn back now... I won't blame you.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'It sounds less like a warning, and more like a plea.'}
{3: 'Before you can answer, the Mist stirs.'}
{3: 'A thousand tiny scraping sounds seep out from deep within it, like a dry, rasping hiss, as if something is grinding its teeth.'}
{2: 'Hah. Sounds like they understood you.', 3: '124', 4: "They don't want us to leave.", 5: '124'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The wall of Mist explodes outward, and a dark shadow tears through.'}
{3: "A sharp clang rings out. The shadow strikes true, hitting the lantern in Nirvatia's hand."}
{3: 'It flies from her grip, crashes to the ground, and rolls away.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Shrieks erupt through the Mist, and countless snarling shadows tear through the veil, rushing straight at you.'}
{3: 'Without thinking, you yank Nirvatia behind you and draw the flintlock at your hip.'}
{3: "The lead shadow's head shatters, dissolving into a cloud of thick, black smoke."}
{2: "You can't use your powers! Leave this to me!", 3: '164'}

{3: 'The shadows fall back, only to reform within the Mist, their claws taking shape again before they lunge once more. You cannot react in time, and a gash is torn across your arm, and blood begins to seep through.'}
{3: 'Firing off several more shots in quick succession, you drive the shadows back to the edge of the Mist. They circle and snarl, biding their time for the next strike.'}
{3: 'You suck at the wound and spit out a mouthful of blood.'}
{2: "It's too dangerous, Nirvatia. Run. I'll cover the rear.", 3: '180'}
{1: '1', 3: 'But you hear no footsteps behind you.'}
{3: 'Nirvatia has not moved. She stands there in silence, her eyes fixed on you.'}
{3: 'The tear in your coat curls open, and blood trickles down your arm. Drop by drop, your blood vanishes into the Mist below.'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'Do you remember what you said? "Some do bad things with good intentions. Others do good while meaning harm."', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Amid the roaring darkness, Nirvatia waits quietly for an answer. Her eyes carry a complicated emotion that is tangled up in guilt.'}
{3: 'Your heart sinks. The woman before you is hiding something, and whatever is happening right now, she is at the center of it.'}
{3: 'You look each other in the eye for a long moment. And then, you answer.'}
{3: 'The conflict in her eyes slowly fades, inch by inch.'}
{3: 'When she looks up again, only resolve remains.'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "Then... see for yourself what I've done.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'In an instant, a dormant power roars awake within her, its invisible pressure rolling across everything around you.'}
{3: 'A dark scythe takes shape in her palm.'}
{3: 'The hand gripping the scythe trembles. As the blade ignites with light, color slowly drains from her lips.'}
{3: 'She can use her powers, but she burns through her life every time she does.'}
{3: 'This time, it is her turn to stand between you and what is coming.'}
{3: 'The scythe has barely taken form before her slash is already flying.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Wherever the light sweeps, the rushing shadows and the suffocating Mist are cleaved apart and scattered. For one breathless moment, the world is clear.'}
{3: 'Then, dark red blood spills from the corner of her lips, followed by a violent cough. Her knees buckle, and she pitches forward.'}
{3: 'You rush to catch her before she hits the ground.'}
{3: 'Her lashes flutter. Her lips part, but barely.'}
{3: 'Her voice fades. Her eyes close, and she goes limp in your arms.'}
{1: 'You glance at the path carved open by her strike. There is not much time.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'The Mist closes in again. You draw the lantern close, and its warm light pushes back the darkness, forming a small circle of safety around the figure in your arms.'}
{1: 'Her brow furrows tight, her breathing rapid and disrupted. Her lips move with murmurs too faint for you to make out.'}
{2: 'Letting me go?', 3: '274', 4: 'But I still have a case to solve.', 5: '274'}
{2: "Let's get you out of this nightmare first.", 3: '275'}
{3: 'You raise a hand, your fingers resting gently against her brow.'}
{3: 'A formless tremor passes through the barrier between two minds, and an invisible bridge takes shape.'}
{3: "The world drops away in an instant, accompanied by a sense of weightlessness. Your mind plunges into the depths of Nirvatia's."}
{3: 'But at the center of her mind... is the Mist.'}
{3: 'The same Mist as the one in the forbidden grounds.'}
{2: "...This isn't right.", 3: '296', 4: 'Why is the Mist here?', 5: '296'}
{3: 'Peering deeper, you see something bleeds through the whiteness.'}
{3: 'The ink spreads through the void, fractures, then folds back on itself, coalescing into twisted, symmetrical shapes that drift and multiply until they fill your entire field of view.'}
{3: 'They are identical to the ink patterns you saw outside the Lantern Chamber.'}
{2: 'Sorry, Nirvatia.', 3: '306', 4: 'But I have to look this time.', 5: '306'}
{3: 'You reach out and touch the nearest blot of ink, and you are greeted by a flash of white—'}
{3: 'Snow, wind, the crackle of burning pine... All of it rushes in at once.'}
{3: 'Sleet batters the stained glass while the pine logs snap and pop in the fireplace.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Bulgakov opens the door to let young Nirvatia in. Her lips are blue from the cold.'}
{3: 'She clutches at her tattered clothes, the snow from her shoes melting into a trail of damp spots across the entryway. She looks like a stray cat that has wandered somewhere warm by mistake.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'By the fireplace, Jagienka and Margaret set down their puzzle and look up in unison.'}
{2: 'Margaret', 3: 'Who is she...? Why are her clothes all torn up?', 4: '3'}
{2: 'Jagienka', 3: "Shh—it's probably another sister Father's brought home.", 4: '2'}
{3: "There is something unreadable in both girls' eyes. Neither moves to welcome Nirvatia."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Bulgakov', 3: 'This is your home from now on.', 4: '4'}
{3: 'The scene jumps forward, settling on a strawberry cake sitting on the table.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The three girls crowd around a single table, sharing a slice of strawberry cake.'}
{3: "Margaret slides the biggest slice with the most strawberries onto Nirvatia's plate, then leans in close, lowering her voice."}
{2: 'Margaret', 3: "Nirvatia, listen... Don't keep coming first in the family tests.", 4: '3'}
{2: 'Margaret', 3: 'Every brother and sister before you who stood out all got taken away by Father for private lessons... and none of them ever came back.', 4: '3'}
{2: 'Jagienka', 3: 'You just love making sure everyone knows how smart you are.', 4: '1'}
{3: "Nirvatia helps herself to a heaping spoonful of cake straight from Jagienka's slice."}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "Dumb kids don't get cake. Smart ones get two slices.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Jagienka lunges to grab it back, but Nirvatia just laughs and shoves the whole slice straight into her mouth. Her cheeks are so stuffed that she cannot get a word out.'}
{3: 'Margaret watches the two of them and bursts out laughing.'}
{3: 'Her laughter still hangs in the air as the scene fades to the gray of a chalkboard.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'In the mansion classroom, Bulgakov stands before the chalkboard.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Jagienka stares down at her fingers. Margaret gives a small shake of her head, silently warning Nirvatia not to raise her hand.'}
{3: 'Margaret mutters under her breath, begging Nirvatia to stop.'}
{3: "Under the desk, Jagienka frantically pinches Nirvatia's leg."}
{2: 'Jagienka', 3: "<size=35>Don't answer, you idiot! If you get it right, he'll—</size>", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'The special undertaker rites of the family go like...', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Bulgakov gives a satisfied nod as Nirvatia finishes her answer.'}
{2: 'Bulgakov', 3: 'Well done, Nirvatia. Come with me to the study.', 4: '4'}
{1: '1', 3: 'She rises and follows the tall figure out the door.'}
{3: 'In the darkness, a dim desk lamp flickers on.'}
{3: 'The curtains are drawn tight. The desk lamp is the only source of light.'}
{3: 'Beside Bulgakov lies a thick ledger, its pages dense with entries. The header of the latest page bears a single number.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Bulgakov slides an inkblot card across to her.'}
{2: 'Bulgakov', 3: 'Relax. Just tell me what you see.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Nirvatia', 3: '...A butterfly. A black butterfly, resting on a white flower.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Bulgakov', 3: "That's not right, Nirvatia. Look again. You're seeing it wrong.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The dark shapes seem to shift before her eyes, as if they are coming alive.'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "Two people, lying in the snow. There's so much blood.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Bulgakov nods, makes a note in his ledger, then slides the second card across.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Bulgakov', 3: 'Who is it?! I need a firm answer!', 4: '18'}
{3: "There is a knock at the door. Margaret and Jagienka's voices come through from outside."}
{2: 'Bulgakov', 3: 'Who allowed you to come bother us?! Leave!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Bulgakov turns back, his hollow smile sliding back into place, and he continues to push an inkblot card toward Nirvatia.'}
{3: "Card after card of inkblots are reflected in the girl's hollow eyes."}
{3: 'The ink bleeds out from the cards, flooding the entire study.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'It spreads over the strawberry cake, the burning fireplace, the two smiling faces.'}
{3: 'The darkness swallows the last trace of warmth—'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Nirvatia jolts awake from the nightmare, drenched in cold sweat.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Two figures sit at the edge of her bed.'}
{3: 'She recoils sharply. Her back hits the headboard, her hand already reaching under her pillow.'}
{3: "Nirvatia's gaze moves between their faces, her expression guarded and distant. It is as if she is looking at two strangers who barged into her room."}
{3: "Margaret slowly reaches up and plucks a white flower from Nirvatia's hair, cradling it in her palm."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Margaret', 3: 'I picked this for you from the cemetery.', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Margaret', 3: "You said you'd never take it off.", 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 3: 'A long moment passes. Then her lashes flutter.'}
{3: 'The moment the name leaves her lips, Nirvatia freezes.'}
{3: 'Relieved and frustrated, Jagienka immediately starts bawling.'}
{2: 'Jagienka', 3: "Are you out of your mind?! You know people don't come back from his place! Why did you volunteer?!", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Nirvatia pulls them both into her arms.'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'Last time I went to drop something off, I caught him talking to the butler outside the study. He said he was going to pick one of you two this time.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "I couldn't let anything happen to you.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "It'll be okay. I'll figure something out. Trust me.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The three of them huddle together under the blankets, crying.'}
{3: 'The snow grows brighter and brighter, until it dissolves into a blinding wall of fog.'}
{3: '...The same fog as the Mist today.'}
{3: 'Bulgakov walks ahead with the soul lantern in his hand as Nirvatia follows close behind.'}
{3: "The lantern's light sweeps across the roadside, casting its glow over rows of empty coffins."}
{3: 'Bulgakov glances back, his voice as gentle as ever.'}
{3: 'She reaches up and touches the white flower in her hair.'}
{3: 'The lantern light ventures deeper into the Mist, then slowly fades away.'}
{3: 'And that is where the memory ends.'}
{3: 'You stand at the edge of the ink.'}
{3: 'You gaze out across this mindscape, and the ink-stained images float into view one after another.'}

{3: "Bulgakov's tampering has left its marks: butterflies wrenched into scythes, white flowers painted over into pools of blood. The original images still linger underneath, like a draft smothered by cheap paint."}
{3: 'Everything that has been tampered with stands out plain as day.'}
{2: 'So... these are the things that were changed.', 3: '684'}
{1: 'Find the first stroke, and the rest can be traced back from there.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'You raise a hand, but your fingers pause, hovering in midair.'}
{1: 'The little girl from Mistrellis Street, the orange candy, the white flower placed inside a palm...'}
{1: 'Fabricating a kinder memory, or restoring a cruel truth... Which one actually saves her?', 7: '1'}
{2: 'No.', 3: '692', 4: "A detective's job is to uncover the truth.", 5: '692'}
{2: 'Your life is yours to decide, Nirvatia.', 3: '694'}
{1: 'A soft thread of light spills from your fingertips.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Slowly and gently, you move like someone mending a piece of porcelain that was shattered once before being carelessly glued back together.'}
{1: 'The spreading ink begins to flow backward, slowly drawing in inch by inch. The fractured, scattered shapes are smoothed over by the light, folding back into place.'}
{1: 'The ink drawings that had been twisted into scythes and coffins slowly return to what they once were.', 7: '1'}
{3: 'The cold mist of the forbidden grounds and the warm glow of a lantern come back into view.'}
{3: 'Your eyes open. Something warm trickles from your nose and drips onto your collar—blood.'}
{3: 'The backlash has not worn off yet, and every one of your limbs feels like lead. Even reaching up to wipe the blood away takes twice the effort.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'But the furrowed brow of the one cradled in your arms slowly begins to ease.'}
{3: 'Her rapid, disrupted breaths settle little by little.'}
{3: 'You look down at her peaceful face and let out a long, slow breath.'}
{3: 'A force slams into you, sending you crashing back-first into the cold stone floor.'}
{3: 'The black scythe blade sweeps high, its edge leveled at your throat.'}
